_about: Daily targeted Google searches (via Serper). 'daily' runs every day for every area; 'pool' is rotated, a fresh slice each day. {area}, {area_bn}, {variant}, {katha} are filled in. tbs: qdr:d day, qdr:w week, qdr:m month, empty = any time. 'portal_daily' = one search per portal EVERY day (area and keyword rotate with the date), so no portal is ever missing from a day's run. Daily Facebook searches carry price words so most posts found state a price (tested 20 Nov: 8 of 16 priced vs 1 of 18 without).

daily.label: Facebook groups
daily.q: site:facebook.com/groups "{area}" flat sale (price OR crore OR lakh OR tk)

daily.label: Facebook groups (Bangla)
daily.q: site:facebook.com/groups {area_bn} ফ্ল্যাট OR প্লট বিক্রি (দাম OR কোটি OR লাখ OR টাকা)
